context: Build tags and WebKitGTK on Ubuntu 24.04

checklist.name: production_tags
checklist.description: Explains that a plain go build compiles but wails.Run refuses to start without the dev or production tag, and uses -tags desktop,production for the release build.

checklist.name: webkit2_41
checklist.description: Adds the webkit2_41 tag alongside desktop,production and installs libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev, because Ubuntu 24.04 does not ship the webkit2gtk-4.0 development package.

checklist.name: gtk3_not_gtk4
checklist.description: Installs the GTK3 development package (libgtk-3-dev or equivalent), a C compiler, and pkg-config, and does not treat 4.1 as GTK4.

checklist.name: ci_untagged
checklist.description: Says the vet and test job builds without the dev or production tag, so it does not compile the cgo webview code and does not need the GTK or WebKitGTK packages.

checklist.name: frontend_first
checklist.description: Builds the frontend before go build so the embedded assets contain index.html.
